text.title: Freelancer Weekly Report Template Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether a weekly cadence applies at all, then on what kind of week it was — blocked, shipping, or one where a risk is surfacing — to the rule that governs the block being written.

decision-tree.root-question: Is the engagement longer than two weeks, and has the client not opted out of a weekly cadence in favour of milestone reports?

branch.when: engagement under two weeks, or the client explicitly asked for milestone reports only

conclusion.verdict: skip; a single closeout report covers a short engagement, and a declined cadence turns a trust instrument into filtered noise — emit a structured skip naming which condition held

branch.when: multi-week engagement on an agreed weekly cadence
branch.question: What did this week actually look like?

branch.when: nothing merged; the week went on debugging, waiting or a blocked dependency
branch.question: Is the blocker on the client's side — their access, decision, content or environment?

branch.when: yes; the work is waiting on someone at the client

conclusion.verdict: move that item out of next into asks with the same date and a named owner; left in next it reads as your work in progress and the slip lands on you

branch.when: no; it is the operator's own overrun and the temptation is to skip this week's send

conclusion.verdict: send in the fixed slot with shipped empty and the reason stated; the first skipped bad week is when silence starts meaning trouble

branch.when: work shipped and the report is being drafted
branch.question: Can every shipped row be attached to something the client can open, and is in-flight work described without a percentage?

branch.when: some rows are prose descriptions of effort with no link

conclusion.verdict: attach a merged PR URL, commit SHA, ticket id or deployed URL, or delete the row; unlinked rows are read as claims when an invoice is questioned months later

branch.when: rows link out but in-flight work is reported as 'about 80% done'

conclusion.verdict: report completed over total countable units — '8 of 11 endpoints migrated'; percent-complete is an unfalsifiable self-assessment the client plans money against

branch.when: rows link out, progress is counted, and the report is otherwise ready

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; fill shipped, next, risks and asks and check each block against the rule set before sending in the cadence slot

branch.when: something is about to go wrong and the client needs to know this week
branch.question: Is there a mitigation with an owner and a date by which the decision must be taken?

branch.when: yes; response and decision date both exist

conclusion.verdict: record it as {risk, mitigation, owner} plus the decision date; a risk with no response is read as commentary and quoted back after it fires

branch.when: no mitigation; what is actually needed is a decision from a specific person

conclusion.verdict: move it to asks naming one human, the exact decision or artefact, and a needed-by date; an ask addressed to a group is answered by nobody
